regions.name: Flats Line
regions.lore: Observation came before defence. These dishes were left waiting, not destroyed in battle.
regions.art: Low salt plates, buried receiver bowls, empty sky; a trace of ochre ceramic after restoration.
regions.mechanic: Hit a memory block, break a marked brick, enter a maintenance conduit and restore a beacon.
regions.reward: A map fragment and a visible roof route to remember.
regions.revisit: Dash plus Air Jump opens the maintenance roof from the Wire.
regions.assets: Salt floor kit; buried dish landmark; shutter and brick states; quiet wind and first-receiver hum.

regions.name: Listening Field
regions.lore: One intact dish was isolated deliberately. The fourth ear is a question, not a fourth compulsory switch.
regions.art: Dish bowls and survey posts; amber filaments; three distinct window patterns around a shared shaft.
regions.mechanic: Manual selector and catch; dish alignment; cleared intake. Find permanent Dash in the Upper Amplifier.
regions.reward: Dash, a hub lift, restored workshop windows and the Stand route.
regions.revisit: Air Jump reaches the Fourth Dish archive. The lower service path leads to Drowned before the Field is complete.
regions.assets: Three-ear landmark at two distances; workshop kit; selector/catch/lift states; registered memory layer; cable pulses.

regions.name: The Stand
regions.lore: Civilian receiver frames became braces and barricades. The surviving wiring records an emergency choice.
regions.art: Braced diagonals, broken rim landmark, sheltered dark pockets and slate storm light.
regions.mechanic: Store conductor charge, then redirect it into a bridge motor. Charge is held; ambient thunder is not the timer.
regions.reward: A latched sheltered bridge and restored feeder.
regions.revisit: Drowned sluice and Approach service return shorten travel. Optional collapse trial has a completed bypass.
regions.assets: Brace and shelter kit; conductor/gauge/reservoir/bridge states; distant rim; sheltered and exposed weather stems.

regions.name: Drowned Array
regions.lore: The reservoirs were diverted to keep distant hardware alive; abandoned survey marks remain below the line.
regions.art: Horizontal water marks, drowned masts, depth gauges and green-gray substrate; fixed dry edges stay legible.
regions.mechanic: High/middle/low water states and guided floats. Find permanent Air Jump in the exposed survey gallery.
regions.reward: Dry main street, Air Jump, freight lift to Array and Stand sluice.
regions.revisit: Cycling side basin remains optional; the main return never requires replaying a full tide cycle.
regions.assets: Rim and service-street kit; water surface with stable collision boundary; three pump positions; float rails; submerged mast landmark.

regions.name: The Wire
regions.lore: Hand-numbered clamps and inspection shelters show the labour behind an apparently empty crossing.
regions.art: Huge negative space, sagging cables, subdued clouds and pale copper clamps.
regions.mechanic: Recallable transport with safe inspection platforms; optional environmental dash-refill chain.
regions.reward: A permanent fast carriage between Stand and Array.
regions.revisit: A later roof lead returns to the Flats using Dash and Air Jump.
regions.assets: Two non-repeating pylon views; cable tiles; carriage docks and recall controls; low cloud planes; cable tension audio.

regions.name: The Array
regions.lore: The building is a working machine: shafts, weights and cable runs explain its height.
regions.art: Repeated ceramic ribs, tall counterweight shafts and warm instruments against cold slit windows.
regions.mechanic: Select lift destinations and retain a counterweight using the established mechanical catch rule.
regions.reward: A persistent vertical spine and the Approach route.
regions.revisit: Freight and Wire entrances meet at a familiar loading floor; recalls work from both.
regions.assets: Vertical shaft kit; counterweight pair; selector with shaped destination labels; lift recall poses; instrument hum layers.

regions.name: The Approach
regions.lore: Many small routes converge beneath the intact source. The service line reveals where the network began.

regions.reward: A return to the Stand and an overview of incomplete feeder projects.
regions.revisit: The service elevator makes remaining restoration projects convenient to revisit.
regions.assets: Dense cable supports; shared Stand elevator shaft; feeder board with four distinct shapes; optional swarm boundary.

regions.name: The Gate
regions.lore: The hardware never stopped waiting. Restoration answers what the Spark can carry, not every question about why it was silenced.

regions.revisit: Inspect changed views and remaining archives; no forced new run that erases discoveries.
regions.assets: Unique source aperture; aligned dormant/active silhouettes; four-feed switchboard; restrained completion transition; revisitable ambience.

blocks.escape: Fall to safe shelf; optional reward only.

blocks.name: Freight shaft

blocks.name: Wall-kick shaft

blocks.name: Maintenance ladder
blocks.lesson: Deliberately enter a ladder to inspect a service route; jumping exits it.
blocks.escape: Stable top and bottom mounts; never require it until controller tests pass.
blocks.assets: Ladder/rung states, mount anchors and climb animation.

blocks.name: Trip plate and shutter
blocks.lesson: First plate opens a harmless shutter. A later plate previews a timed optional door.
blocks.escape: Timer never seals the only exit; reset and visible retreat floor.
blocks.assets: Pressed/unpressed plate, connected cable and door travel gauge.

blocks.name: Actuator crossing
blocks.lesson: Watch a piston cycle from a protected recess before crossing its marked sweep.
blocks.escape: No blind off-screen activation; checkpoint nearby and safe bay between cycles.
blocks.assets: Retracted/warning/moving/held piston states and stable sweep boundary.

puzzles.name: Borrowed Current
puzzles.insight: Temporary power and a persistent mechanical catch are different states.
puzzles.reward: West ear, access to Dash and a permanent hub lift.
puzzles.reset: Unfinished selector returns to lift supply with a safe floor below. The catch unfolds a permanent service stair; the completed catch, stair and route never reset.
states: Observe
Selector and both outputs are visible. The lift is down; the ear is dormant.
Power lift
Choose the lift output and ride to the upper safety catch.
Latch catch
Engage the manual catch. It retains the platform and unfolds the permanent service stair, which was unavailable before this step.
Reroute supply
Return by the newly unfolded stair; select the ear receiver. The catch retains the lift.
Route open
Ear wakes. Continue to Dash and open the hub return; persist both discoveries.

puzzles.name: Stored Storm
puzzles.insight: Charge can be collected and held, then deliberately routed; distant lightning is atmosphere.
puzzles.reward: Latched bridge and restored Stand feeder.
puzzles.reset: Unfinished charge returns to neutral on death; bridge completion persists. Safe bay is outside the discharge channel.
states: Observe
Inspect the rod, shaped reservoir gauge and bridge motor from shelter.
Collect
Select reservoir input. The deterministic machine cue advances the gauge.
Hold
Charge stays stored. There is no short reaction window.
Discharge
Select bridge motor. Rod animation and stable boundary communicate the event.
Bridge latched
Bridge stays open; decorative lightning can be disabled without changing access.

puzzles.name: Street Beneath the Static
puzzles.insight: Removing water reveals a street; raising a guided carrier opens a different return.
puzzles.reward: Air Jump, dry service street, freight lift and upper conduit.
puzzles.reset: On death/reload, an unfinished main basin resets LOW and respawns at a fixed dry anchor. Air Jump persists. Dry stairs and controls work in every state. Completion keeps the street drained; the optional basin cycles separately.
states: High
Observe submerged service markings from the dry rim.
Middle
Lower water to the next mark; the fixed control stair remains usable.
Low
Recover the pump impeller in the service street; visit the Air Jump gallery.
Fit impeller
Return by the dry stair and fit the impeller. The manual bleed enabled discovery; the repaired pump now powers the float.
Float raised
Use the separate guided chamber to reach the upper landing; controls are outside its hazard.
Return latched
Open the conduit, drain the main street permanently and enable the freight connection.
